title: On the LLM Verification for Argument Graph Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27361v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems can formalize natural-language argumentation end-to-end, turning plain text into structured graphs by classifying components, connecting them with relations, and enriching the resulting graphs into formal models. Quality assurance for those graphs is almost always another LLMs: a reviewer, judge, or critic agent. On the other side, in adjacent neuro-symbolic fields, such generated output is often verified symbolically by external checks and solvers. In this work, we argue that in argument graph verification, the allocation should be similar, and based on what each instrument can guarantee. We propose layered verification: starting from deterministic checks, moving to solver-based and LLM reviews, and utilizing debate only under uncertainty, leaving human judgment for what no other instrument can decide. We ground our principle with a study on human-annotated graphs with injected structural defects. An LLM reviewer

translated_title: 论论辩图生成中大语言模型验证
translated_abstract: 多智能体大语言模型系统能够对自然语言论证进行端到端的形式化处理，通过对论证成分进行分类、用关系将它们连接起来，并将所得的图丰富为形式化模型，从而将纯文本转化为结构化图。对这些图的质量保障几乎总是依赖另一个大语言模型来完成，即审查者、评判者或批评者智能体。另一方面，在相邻的神经符号领域，此类生成输出通常通过外部检查和求解器进行符号化验证。在本工作中，我们主张在论辩图验证中，任务的分配应当类似，并基于每种工具所能保证的能力。我们提出了分层验证方法：从确定性检查开始，进而采用基于求解器和大语言模型的审查，并仅在存在不确定性时使用辩论机制，将其他任何工具都无法判断的内容留给人类裁决。我们通过一项在人工标注的图中注入结构缺陷的研究来支撑这一原则。大语言模型审查者……
tldr: 本文提出了一种面向论辩图生成的分层验证框架，主张根据各类工具（确定性检查、求解器、大语言模型、辩论、人类）所能保证的能力来合理分配验证任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a layered verification framework for argument graph generation, advocating that verification tasks should be allocated based on what each instrument—deterministic checks, solvers, LLMs, debate, and human judgment—can guarantee.
